record.what_it_does: Brex is a unified spend-management platform (corporate cards, expenses, reimbursements, bill pay, travel) that exposes REST APIs to power internal tools and custom workflows.
record.auth_notes: Existing Brex customers can self-serve a static 'user token' (Bearer) from their dashboard after an admin accepts the developer API agreement. Third-party partner apps instead use OpenID-Connect-compliant OAuth2 (Authorization Code Grant for acting on behalf of a client, or Client Credentials Grant for the Onboarding API), but obtaining a client_id/client_secret requires contacting Brex developer support directly — there is no self-serve partner registration.
record.access_notes: Bearer-token access is only available to companies that already have a live Brex corporate account (admin must sign in to dashboard.brex.com and accept the developer API agreement) — there's no free/sandbox signup for non-customers. Partner OAuth2 credentials (client_id/secret) are only issued after contacting Brex's developer support team.
record.main_blocker: Partner OAuth2 credentials require manually contacting Brex developer support for approval, and bearer-token auth needs an existing paid Brex corporate account
